request: if 5 pens cost £3.50, how much do 8 pens cost?

beats.intent: Five pen blocks in a bar costing £3.50 altogether
beats.narration: Five pens cost three pounds fifty.
beats.code:
stage.title("Finding the price of one")
pw = 1.0
five = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=pw, height=0.6, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.5) for _ in range(5)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0).move_to([-6 + 2.5 * pw, 1.4, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(five))
stage.add(five)
stage.play(*[FadeIn(Text("pen", font_size=22).move_to(b)) for b in five])
stage.label(five, "£3.50", direction=RIGHT, color=BLUE)

beats.narration: Find one pen first: three fifty shared between five is seventy pence.
beats.code:
one = five[0].copy().set_color(YELLOW).set_fill(YELLOW, opacity=0.5)
stage.play(one.animate.move_to([-5.5, 0.2, 0]))
stage.add(one)
stage.label(one, "1 pen = 70p", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: Eight pen blocks built from the single one: 8 × 70p
beats.narration: Then build up to eight pens: eight lots of seventy pence.
beats.code:
eight = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=pw * 0.7, height=0.6, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.5) for _ in range(8)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0).move_to([-6 + 4 * 0.7 * pw, -1.0, 0])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[TransformFromCopy(one, b) for b in eight], lag_ratio=0.1))
stage.add(eight)
stage.label(eight, "£5.60", direction=RIGHT, color=GREEN)

beats.narration: Divide to find one, then multiply to find eight: five pounds sixty.

request: how many degrees is it from north to south-east, turning clockwise?

beats.intent: An eight-point compass rose: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW
beats.narration: A compass has eight main points, each forty five degrees apart.
beats.code:
stage.title("Compass turns")
c = np.array([-3, -0.3, 0])
names = ["N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW"]
dirs = [np.array([np.sin(k * PI / 4), np.cos(k * PI / 4), 0]) for k in range(8)]
spokes = VGroup(*[Line(c, c + (2.0 if k % 2 == 0 else 1.4) * d, color=GREY_B) for k, d in enumerate(dirs)])
labels = VGroup(*[Text(n, font_size=26).move_to(c + (2.4 if k % 2 == 0 else 1.75) * d) for k, (n, d) in enumerate(zip(names, dirs))])
stage.play(Create(spokes), FadeIn(labels))
stage.add(spokes, labels)

pointer = Arrow(c, c + 1.8 * UP, buff=0, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=8)
stage.play(GrowArrow(pointer))
stage.add(pointer)

beats.intent: The pointer turning clockwise through NE and E to SE, three 45° steps, the swept angle shaded
beats.narration: Turn clockwise: to north east is forty five, to east is ninety, to south east is a hundred and thirty five.
beats.code:
sweep = Arc(radius=0.9, start_angle=PI / 2, angle=-3 * PI / 4, arc_center=c, color=ORANGE, stroke_width=8)
stage.play(Rotate(pointer, angle=-3 * PI / 4, about_point=c), Create(sweep), run_time=2)
stage.add(pointer, sweep)
stage.play(FadeIn(Text("135°", font_size=26, color=ORANGE).move_to(c + 1.3 * np.array([np.sin(3 * PI / 8), np.cos(3 * PI / 8), 0]))))

beats.narration: Three steps of forty five degrees: a hundred and thirty five degrees clockwise.

request: why is the square root of 12 equal to 2 times the square root of 3?

beats.narration: The square root of twelve is the side of a square with area twelve.
beats.code:
stage.title("Simplifying √12")
k = 0.8
side = np.sqrt(12) * k
big = Square(side, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to([-3.2, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(Create(big))
stage.add(big)
a12 = Text("area 12", font_size=30).move_to(big)
stage.play(FadeIn(a12))
stage.label(Line(big.get_corner(DL), big.get_corner(DR)), "√12", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: The square cut into four smaller squares, each of area 3
beats.narration: Cut it into four equal squares. Twelve shared four ways: each has area three.
beats.code:
small = side / 2
quarters = VGroup(*[Square(small, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.25).move_to(big.get_corner(UL) + np.array([(i + 0.5) * small, -(j + 0.5) * small, 0])) for i in range(2) for j in range(2)])
stage.play(FadeOut(a12), Create(quarters))
stage.add(quarters)
stage.play(*[FadeIn(Text("3", font_size=28, color=ORANGE).move_to(q)) for q in quarters])

beats.intent: The big square's side shown as two small sides, each √3
beats.narration: Each small square has side root three, and two of them make the big side. So root twelve is two root three.
beats.code:
left = Line(big.get_corner(UL), big.get_corner(UL) + small * DOWN, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=6)
left2 = Line(big.get_corner(UL) + small * DOWN, big.get_corner(DL), color=YELLOW, stroke_width=6)
stage.play(Create(left), Create(left2))
stage.add(left, left2)
stage.label(left, "√3", direction=LEFT, color=YELLOW)
stage.label(left2, "√3", direction=LEFT, color=YELLOW)

beats.narration: In symbols: twelve is four times three, and the square root of four is two.

request: how do you bisect an angle with a compass?

beats.intent: An angle of 60° between two rays from a point A
beats.narration: Here's an angle at A. We want the line that cuts it exactly in half, with just a compass and a ruler.
beats.code:
stage.title("Bisecting an angle")
A = np.array([-5.6, -2.2, 0])
u = np.array([1, 0, 0])
v = np.array([np.cos(PI / 3), np.sin(PI / 3), 0])
rays = VGroup(Line(A, A + 5 * u, color=WHITE), Line(A, A + 5 * v, color=WHITE))
stage.play(Create(rays))
stage.add(rays)
stage.play(FadeIn(Text("A", font_size=26).next_to(A, DL, buff=0.1)))

beats.intent: An arc centred at A cutting both rays at P and Q
beats.narration: Put the compass point on A and draw an arc that crosses both arms, at P and Q.
beats.code:
arc_a = Arc(radius=2.0, start_angle=-10 * DEGREES, angle=80 * DEGREES, arc_center=A, color=BLUE)
stage.play(Create(arc_a))
stage.add(arc_a)
P, Q = A + 2 * u, A + 2 * v
stage.play(FadeIn(Dot(P, color=BLUE)), FadeIn(Dot(Q, color=BLUE)), FadeIn(Text("P", font_size=24, color=BLUE).next_to(P, DR, buff=0.15)), FadeIn(Text("Q", font_size=24, color=BLUE).next_to(Q, UL, buff=0.2)))

beats.intent: Equal arcs from P and Q crossing at R
beats.narration: Now, with the same opening, draw an arc from P and another from Q. They cross at a point R.
beats.code:
d = 2.981
R = A + d * np.array([np.cos(PI / 6), np.sin(PI / 6), 0])
arc_p = Arc(radius=1.6, start_angle=50 * DEGREES, angle=40 * DEGREES, arc_center=P, color=GREEN)
arc_q = Arc(radius=1.6, start_angle=-30 * DEGREES, angle=40 * DEGREES, arc_center=Q, color=GREEN)
stage.play(Create(arc_p), Create(arc_q))
stage.add(arc_p, arc_q)
stage.play(FadeIn(Dot(R, color=YELLOW)), FadeIn(Text("R", font_size=24, color=YELLOW).next_to(R, UR, buff=0.08)))

beats.intent: The line from A through R splitting the angle into two 30° angles, beside 60° ÷ 2 = 30°
beats.narration: Join A to R and carry on. That line splits the angle into two equal halves, thirty degrees each.
beats.code:
bis = Line(A, A + 5 * np.array([np.cos(PI / 6), np.sin(PI / 6), 0]), color=YELLOW, stroke_width=5)
stage.play(Create(bis))
stage.add(bis)
a1 = Angle(Line(A, A + u), Line(A, R), radius=0.9, color=ORANGE)
a2 = Angle(Line(A, R), Line(A, A + v), radius=1.1, color=ORANGE)
stage.play(Create(a1), Create(a2))
stage.add(a1, a2)
stage.equation(r"60^\circ \div 2 = 30^\circ")
